name: NGC 1032 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1032, an edge-on early-type spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc1032-hubble
story: An isolated galaxy seen edge-on; far out in its halo, the faint, calcium-rich supernova SN 2005E once flared. Hubble looked deep at the explosion site to search for any stars that might have given rise to it.

claims.text: NGC 1032 is an isolated, edge-on, early-type spiral (S0/a) galaxy
SN 2005E was a faint, calcium-rich type Ib supernova in the halo of NGC 1032
Program 13698 imaged the SN 2005E site deeply because shallower imaging showed no underlying stellar system there
